title: Phase 66 EXP-01 registered timing calibration (plan 66-03): exp01-d1-w384-o1000 on system 1632, MPS float32, 5200 steps
committed_before: the first Phase 66 run of any kind; the settings, the cap, the cadence and the reading rule are immutable after the run

settings.orbit_note: Stage-0 training gold record, split train, manifest stage 0; the only record the guarded seam may open

loss.definition: INST-05 data_huber_loss over the windowed gold targets

settings.timing_definitions: synchronized completed-work segments: admission and data load recorded by the CLI; setup (model and optimizer build), the 200 warmup updates, the 5000 measured updates, similarity logging, frozen scoring and publication recorded separately by the fit; every segment wrapped in the MPS _synchronize helper with an injected monotonic clock; seconds_per_step is the measured 5000-update sum over 5000, excluding warmup, logging and scoring; end-to-end seconds per completed step is total wall over 5200

reading_rule.mechanical_pass: all 5200 finite updates, exactly five similarity entries at steps 0/1300/2600/3900/5200, the frozen network score and both comparison rows on the same window, Stage-0 TRAIN-only access evidence, all within the 600-second cap; no E/tier threshold and no expected improvement is imposed
reading_rule.incomplete: an interrupted, over-cap or non-finite attempt records status incomplete with its reason and publishes nothing; it is never retried, extended or resumed and never substitutes for a record
reading_rule.out_of_branch: any outcome this rule does not describe is reported to the orchestrator rather than interpreted; the timing run calibrates cost only, with no learnability, causal or representation claim, and no E value, tier, similarity figure or improvement is read from its record

logger_parity.note: D-10: the real-arm logger-parity receipt from the registered probe run precedes this smoke; admission verifies the receipt is a successful measurement whose bytes match the recorded run commit

context.note: the historical lead's registered branch (144/144 required fields reproduced) is recorded but never required for the independent fit mechanics; the smoke does not rescue, refute or re-interpret it

pinned.note: admission revalidates all 33 PINNED_MODULES digests through load_protocol()

threats.T-66-18: committed-clean pages and registrations with exact digests before any data access; the page digest is pinned and re-checked on every admission, and the evidence order is git-verifiable; no automatic altered retry
threats.T-66-09: Stage-0 TRAIN-only guarded seam, full access attestation and marked diagnostic payload; one train open, zero validation or test opens
